changed.before: I sat with a few clients to watch how they decide to trade now or wait. The question is always the same. Am I ahead of the market or behind it. That's the first thing the screen answers.
changed.after: I observed traders on the desk to understand when they monitor an order and when they intervene. Their question is whether they are ahead of the market or behind it. That is the first thing the screen answers.
